posts.title: Refined LinkedIn: fold LinkedIn job descriptions
posts.description: A free, open-source Chrome extension that folds LinkedIn job descriptions down to the work and the requirements, and greys out jobs you've seen.

posts.title: Minions: AI agents that each live in their own folder
posts.description: Small AI agents on Pi or Claude Code, one folder each, with their own memory, skills and chats. They started from Alejandro AO's video on open-source Dots.

posts.title: Scry: juicy internet data your agent can query
posts.description: A hosted SQL database of public internet data, from Reddit and Common Crawl to 1.7 million live job postings, that also plugs into coding agents.
